numbering: E-decades per BRIEF §5.1; IDs permanent from this point

effects.name: Page-load intro fade
effects.mechanism: CSS keyframe fade on load: header logo/menu/icon + hero widgets run cmsmasters-fade-in / cmsmasters-fade-in-up / fadeIn once, staggered by per-widget delay
effects.note: No preloader overlay exists on this page — shots/home_1440_preload_*.jpg show the page itself fading in. The theme CSS ships cmsmasters-page-preloader-* keyframes but they are unused here (analysis_css.json#keyframes).

effects.name: Sticky content block
effects.mechanism: Native position:sticky on a text column inside a taller two-column section; no transform involved (probe found no animated channel, which confirms native sticky)

effects.name: Scroll vertical parallax (element drift)
effects.mechanism: basicScroll-driven translateY mapped linearly to the element's traversal of the viewport; travel = cms_scroll_vertical_speed × 100px

fitRms_S05.cite: effects/parallax_S05_speed2.json#fit.cubicBezierRms — poor single-bezier fit because the probed range includes dwell outside the active viewport window; declared timing is linear (widget_settings cms_scroll_vertical_timing)

S17.value: not measured — both S17 elements showed no motion in two probe attempts each (effects/parallax_S17_speed1_retry.json, effects/parallax_S17_speed2b.json); settings still declare vertical speed 1–2

effects.name: Scroll-linked appear of fixed action cluster
effects.mechanism: Fixed-position widget cluster (right edge, z-index 9998) translates up 40px and fades as the page scroll crosses 10–20% of document height; vertical speed 0.4, opacity channel on

effects.name: Scroll-entrance reveal (block)
effects.mechanism: IntersectionObserver-triggered one-shot CSS keyframe (cmsmasters-fade-in-up etc.) per block; element fades in and translates up

distancePx.cite: derived/widget_settings.json#widgets.cmsmasters-fancy-text[0].settings.animated_distance.size — declared on the one widget that serializes it; generic blocks: not measured (one-shot animation, fired before dense sampling can attach)

effects.implementedNote: partial-distance: duration+timing measured; 60px travel is the theme's serialized default on fancy-text, applied to all reveals as an honest approximation

effects.name: Sequential stagger reveal
effects.mechanism: Same keyframes as E20 with data-animation-type=sequental and a fixed per-sibling delay

effects.name: Image accordion (hover expand)
effects.mechanism: Row of image panels; hovering a panel expands it (flex-grow transition) while overlay opacity crossfades 0↔1; titles fade at the right edge via a linear-gradient mask

growTransition.value: not measured — flex-grow transition duration is not exposed by the hover probe; theme-wide transition tally is 0.3–0.4s ease

effects.name: Highlight-title reveal
effects.mechanism: Headline widget whose highlight span animates in on reveal (gradient shift / underline draw keyframes); rides the same reveal trigger as E20

duration.value: not measured — one-shot on reveal; not re-triggerable for dense sampling without a reload per instance

effects.name: Typed text rotator
effects.mechanism: typed.js-style character type/delete loop inside the hero H1 (blinking caret keyframe typedjsBlink)

typingSpeedMs.value: not measured — per-character cadence not serialized; visible cadence is the typed.js default band

effects.thaiNote: Per-character typing MUST use Intl.Segmenter(th, grapheme) — BRIEF §6.5; fall back to line-level if Thai detected without Segmenter support.

effects.name: Counter count-up
effects.mechanism: jquery-numerator tween of textContent from data-from-value to data-to-value on first view

effects.name: Image marquee
effects.mechanism: JS-driven translate3d loop on a duplicated track (2 copies), linear, leftward, pausing/behavior on hover disabled; px/s scales ≈ ×30 with the widget speed setting

effects.name: Swap-button hover
effects.mechanism: Button label/icon swap with a color/background crossfade on hover; no geometric movement of the button itself (lift 0, scale 1, magnetic false)

effects.name: Image pan on hover
effects.mechanism: Framed image pans vertically inside its clip box while hovered (scroll_type hover, direction vertical); frame itself does not move

panSpeed.value: not measured — pan animates the inner img, outside the hover probe's reach on the frame element (effects/hover_imagescroll.json shows the frame static)

effects.name: Featured-box hover state
effects.mechanism: Card-style feature tiles swap text/background color on hover (0.3s transitions); no movement (probe: lift 0, no tilt, no magnet)

changedOnHoverCount.cite: hover_home_1440.json (6 of 43 probed elements changed state)

effects.name: Global micro-transitions
effects.mechanism: Theme-wide 0.3s/0.4s ease transitions on background, border, box-shadow, transform for links and buttons

dominant.value: background/border/box-shadow 0.3s + transform 0.4s ease (93 elements), + border-radius variant (27)

effects.name: Continuous media carousel (Swiper)
effects.mechanism: Swiper carousel in continuous-conveyor mode: very long transition (slider_speed 10000ms) with a short autoplay delay (500ms) approximates constant linear motion; bullets navigation
effects.buildIntent: yes — as a hand-written conveyor track, not Swiper (rule 4)

effects.name: Before/after comparison slider
effects.mechanism: Two stacked images with a draggable/clickable divider; horizontal, handle rendered, divider starts at 55%

effects.name: Ambient background drift
effects.mechanism: Hero background layer drifts ±5% in X/Y with a slow scale pulse, looping (anime.js-driven); observed cycle ~16s vs declared 15

fitNote.value: rms 0.042 — looping multi-channel drift, not a single tween; rebuild as sine-based x/y drift

effects.name: Header (absolute, scrolls away)
effects.mechanism: Header is position:absolute over the hero and simply scrolls out; headroom.js ships in the bundle with slide/flip keyframes but no headroom classes exist in the rendered DOM — inactive on this page

headroomPresence.value: bundle only — 23_headroom.min.js loaded; no .headroom-* class in dom/home_1440.html

effects.buildIntent: yes — static absolute header; hide/show NOT built (inactive on source page)

effects.name: Timed popup modal
effects.mechanism: Full-viewport fixed overlay (z-index max) opened by a time trigger after load; dismissible via close button

startPopup.cite: derived/widget_settings.json#widgets.cmsmasters-time-popup[0].settings.start_popup — units not serialized; observed to fire during the capture session

closeBehavior.value: close button (menu probe clicked .cmsmasters-popup-close and no navigation occurred)

effects.name: Offcanvas menu
effects.mechanism: Hamburger toggle opens an offcanvas navigation panel (widget carries the nav menu); verified open state captured at 390

absences.evidence: cursorNone=false; no custom-cursor element in DOM; 16_custom-cursor.min.js ships but is not instantiated
vanilla-tilt loaded, zero data-tilt attributes in DOM; all hover probes tilt=false
preloader keyframes exist in theme CSS but no preloader element renders; preload shots show the page itself
0 magnetic across 43 hover probes and 4 precision hover probes
stack is Swiper + anime.js + basicScroll + headroom + jQuery; libprobe has no trigger data
